GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Straight To The Front and allowed to dictate terms No Pace On Settled Down 1/2 Lengths Clear (1st 750m in 47.44), Ridden Along Straightening Up Kept Finding , today had all favours ! - had # support,all favours

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down 3 Wide 5th 3 Lengths had no favours Out On A Limb out Four Wide x 500m, couldn't quicken but Kept Trying Sound Effort - was weighted to beat stalemate home wherever they finished, stablemate was backed in and won - # 3-4 Wide gave all

Jumped Fast Ridden Along Straight To The Front Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Soon After allowed to dictate terms and that was that, asked to go at the 500m Kept Finding in the end fell in and 2nd was unlucky, # dictated, found
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out round home turn and when placed under pressure near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Five Wide from Outside Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear on the rail x 800m, Joined x 600m Ridden Along 400m same found 2 Lengths Straightening Up kept on tough Collared Near line - 1st last crack gap to 3rd, # solid Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Contacted rail leaving mounting yard and vetted behind the barriers. After beginning well, settled in a more forward position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped just ok Wide out went back anyway settled down last spot the leader 9 Lengths & second last runner 3 Lengths (800m), cornered last still albeit closer, did make good Ground into third # good from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported from the wide gate was unable to obtain a forward position, so elected to go back behind the field, however; filly then seemed to switch off and lost ground-added continued to apply pressure to filly and in the home straight when brought wide, mount responded and made good ground in the run to the winning post.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Pushed fwd & raced 4th Two Wide (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along 3 Wide @ 400m & Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 200m & ran on soundly in last 150m. # Good last 150m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a head, held together much same to turn 0.75 Lengths Two Wide , Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: In the early part of the home straight, laid in and near the 150m, shifted in before being corrected.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Went Forward Four Wide Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 1 Lengths had no favours Out On A Limb to Straightening Up Couldn'T Go On @ 300m, # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Leaving the 300m, laid in and steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only averagely from the rails gate Ridden Along ended up final few close up in a bunched lot 4 Lengths (800m), stayed rail Straight no room, over heels Soon After went to the line untested # no room straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Tightened and hampered near the 900m. Held up for a run from the 100m and went to the end of the race without being fully tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along ! Went Forward Settled Down 1/2 Lengths Clear race run to suit , Hard Ridden 400 same led x 2 Lengths x 200 Kept Trying (b/1st) # dictated, found
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped.
